components.note: tab:p01-notation-variants gives Whitehead-Russell PM I 1910 (Peano/Russell tradition), Lukasiewicz 1929 (Polish), Hilbert-Ackermann 1928 (Hilbert), Gentzen 1935 (Gentzen) forms for negation, conjunction, inclusive disjunction, implication, biconditional, universal and existential quantification; the four bib keys exist in handbook/bib/handbook.bib.

The first column keys each row to the registered handbook symbol (neg, land, lor, to, leftrightarrow, forall, exists, all present in handbook/registry/symbols.csv); 263-267 and 295-302 distinguish bibliographic from normative use, edition specificity, Lukasiewicz's variable type, Gentzen's defined abbreviation and sequent arrow.
